typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchiveFullPath as string (),
	ArchivePath as string (),
	DB as string (),
	FalloutArchivePath as string (),
	FallOutFileName as string (),
	FallOutQuery as string (),
	InboundFileName as string (),
	InputFile as string (),
	MailFrom as string (),
	MailTo as string (),
	MessageSource as string (),
	OutboundFileName as string (),
	OutboundFilePath as string (),
	OutputFullPath as string (),
	PWD as string (),
	RUNID as string (),
	TotalRecords as integer (),
	USER as string ()
}

source(output(
		HCID as string,
		EFF_DATE as string,
		TERM_DATE as string,
		COB_IND as string,
		GROUP_ID as string,
		END as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(EFF_DT = iif(isNull(EFF_DATE) || length(trim(EFF_DATE)) == 0, toDate(toString('1900-01-01', 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"), toDate(toString((substring(toString(EFF_DATE), toInteger(5), toInteger(4)) + '-' + substring(toString(EFF_DATE), toInteger(1), toInteger(2)) + '-' + substring(toString(EFF_DATE), toInteger(3), toInteger(2))), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy")),
		TERM_DT = iif(isNull(TERM_DATE) || length(trim(TERM_DATE)) == 0, toDate(toString('9999-12-31', 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"), toDate(toString((substring(toString(TERM_DATE), toInteger(5), toInteger(4)) + '-' + substring(toString(TERM_DATE), toInteger(1), toInteger(2)) + '-' + substring(toString(TERM_DATE), toInteger(3), toInteger(2))), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy")),
		RUNID = toString($RUNID),
		FILE_NAME = toString(right($InputFile, locate('\\', reverse($InputFile), 1) - 1)),
		HCID = trim(HCID)) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive(EFF_DT = EFF_DT) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		TERM_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		HCID as string,
		COB_IND as string,
		EFF_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		RUNID as string,
		FILE_NAME as string,
		GROUP_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		TERM_DATE = TERM_DT,
		HCID,
		COB_IND,
		EFF_DATE = EFF_DT,
		RUNID,
		FILE_NAME,
		GROUP_ID)) ~> OLEDBDestination
